title: build: remove obsolete Go module replace and exclude directives
body:
Version-suffixed `go install` commands reject Prometheus's root module because its `go.mod` contains `replace` and `exclude` directives. Remove the obsolete Cloud Go replacement and the historical Linode, grpc-gateway, and Google API exclusions so promtool can be installed this way.

Also remove the duplicate Cloud Go replacement from the UI tooling module and the old Cloud Go/genproto exclusions from the remote-storage example. Current dependencies no longer need these workarounds. No requirements or checksums change. Comparing package and test dependency providers before and after, in workspace and standalone modes and including build tools, found no version changes. The only selected-module change is that the unused root `cloud.google.com/go` module is no longer replaced by v0.123.0 and resolves to v0.112.2.

Validation on Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64:

- `make test GO_ONLY=1` and `make lint` with the repository-pinned golangci-lint v2.13.1 passed.
- Standalone tests for promtool, GCE and Linode discovery, Google IAM remote storage, and tracing passed. Both affected nested modules passed workspace tests; UI tooling also passed standalone tests. Remote-storage workspace lint passed.
- `GOWORK=off go mod tidy -diff` and `go mod verify` passed in all three affected modules.
- A version-suffixed `go install github.com/prometheus/prometheus/cmd/promtool@<version>` passed for exact commit `d58bf6dfde06`, served under a synthetic version through a local file module proxy with a fresh module cache. The installed binary ran successfully and its Go build metadata matched that version. The same harness rejected the unchanged base archive specifically because of its directives.

Two additional checks fail identically on base commit `296080c0a504` and this change: standalone remote-storage tests hit the existing `ToMetadata` return-value mismatch in `example_write_adapter/server.go:107`; UI tooling lint reports `exitAfterDefer`, `ifElseChain`, and `unconvert` in `gen_functions_docs/main.go`. These are outside this module cleanup.

Existing release tags remain unchanged; `@latest` benefits once a release includes this change.

#### Which issue(s) does the PR fix:

Fixes #9958

#### Release notes for end users (**ALL** commits must be considered).
*Reviewers should verify clarity and quality.*

```release-notes
[BUGFIX] Build: Allow installing promtool with version-suffixed go install commands
```
